description: Verify whether a specific colour is available before configure_product. Returns in_stock boolean, expected_restock_date if out of stock, and up to 5 alternative in-stock colours ordered by similarity. Call this when a customer requests a named colour or when you want to prevent a configure_product failure due to an out-of-stock selection. Duo Roller: colour is one blockout and one sheer written "Blockout + Sheer" (get_product returns duo_fabrics).

colour_name.description: Colour the customer asked for: an exact name, or a family such as grey or white. For a Duo Roller write "Blockout + Sheer"

product_id.description: Product id, for example roller-blockout or venetian-25mm-aluwood

name: check_colour_stock
title: Check colour stock
